name: Vergence Matching
summary: Candidate objects near a head ray move slowly back and forth in depth, and the system selects the one whose motion matches the user's vergence eye movements.
howItWorks: A cone cast from the head (or hand/gaze) pre-selects the 2 or 4 nearest candidates within 10°. Each candidate oscillates in depth with a unique phase (harmonic motion, 2° vergence amplitude, 1 s cycle) and is scaled to keep a constant visual angle. Pearson correlation between the object's depth motion and the relative pupil positions (no gaze calibration needed) identifies the attended object. Threshold-based variant selects hands-free when correlation stays above 0.8; trigger-assisted variant highlights the best match and the user confirms with a controller button. In a study (N=12, HTC Vive Pro Eye) targets as small as 0.25° were selectable at 0.2–30 m, with completion times of about 3.2–3.9 s; trigger-assisted with 2 candidates was fastest, most accurate and preferred.

relationships.note: Same cone pre-selection followed by motion-correlation disambiguation, but using depth (vergence) instead of smooth pursuit.
